public_mechanism.primary_source: Jean-Baptiste Mouret and Jeff Clune, Illuminating search spaces by mapping elites, 2015
source_supported_core: solutions are mapped into a user-chosen behavior/feature space
the feature space is discretized into behavior niches/cells
the archive maintains a high-performing elite for each represented behavioral region
a candidate may populate an empty cell or replace the incumbent when it performs better in the same cell
public_mechanism.adaptation: Use a fixed four-cell role-local descriptor and one independently readback-qualified elite per cell. No evolutionary runtime, external evaluator, or hosted optimizer is on the accepted route.

scope_limit: Constructed four-cell role-local assignment archive trace only. This does not reproduce evolutionary MAP-Elites search, prove optimal behavior descriptors, or establish quality-diversity performance beyond the fixed trace.
